data.body_html:
A marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2029 turns the Costa del Sol’s golden hour into a private studio on the water. Depart Puerto Banús aboard a 12.5m Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with the Sierra Blanca mountains glowing behind you and the Mediterranean reflecting every shade of amber. From €749 for 2 hours, this is a straight-up, no-surprises way to capture editorial-quality portraits, influencer content, or family memories – with skipper, drinks, and snacks included.

Why a Sunset Photoshoot on a Yacht?

Golden hour in Marbella runs roughly 19:00–20:30 in summer, when the sun drops behind La Concha and paints the sky in warm gradients. On a yacht, you get unbroken 360° views – no crowds, no buildings, no distractions. The water acts as a natural reflector, softening shadows and adding a subtle glow to skin tones. It’s the same light that draws fashion photographers to the Côte d’Azur, but here it’s half the price and far less crowded.

Your Yacht for the Session: Astondoa 40 & Azimut 39

Both yachts are 12.5m flybridge cruisers with clean, photogenic lines. The Astondoa 40 sleeps 9 passengers, the Azimut 39 up to 11. Each has a spacious foredeck with sun pads, a shaded aft cockpit, and a sleek profile that looks great in wide shots. No clutter, no brand logos – just clean marine design. The skipper handles all navigation, so you focus entirely on your shoot.

What’s Included in the €749 Sunset Session?

The price is flat and transparent: €749 for 2 hours. That covers:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full session
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, nuts, chips)
  • Full insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no tax surprises

You bring your camera, your talent, and your vision. The yacht leaves from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute walk from the Golden Mile hotels. For larger groups or longer sessions, see our full fleet.

Best Spots for Golden Hour Photography

The skipper knows the local angles. Typical routes head west toward the Cala del Faro lighthouse or east past Marbella Marina and the Río Verde estuary. Key backdrops include:

  • La Concha mountain – turns pink and purple at sunset
  • Puerto Banús skyline – luxury yachts and palms in silhouette
  • Cala Cortés – a quiet cove with crystal water
  • Cabopino dunes – natural coastline, no buildings

You can request a specific route when booking. The skipper will position the yacht bow-first into the setting sun for dramatic backlighting, or side-on to catch the reflection on the water.

How to Book Your 2029 Sunset Session

Reserve via WhatsApp for instant confirmation. We need your preferred date, group size, and any extras (champagne, flowers, photographer). Payment is by bank transfer or card link. Cancellations are free up to 48 hours before departure. For availability, contact us directly – we’ll confirm within 2 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time does a sunset photoshoot session start?

Sessions typically depart at 18:00 in summer (June–August) and 17:00 in spring/autumn. Golden hour lasts about 45 minutes, so we time departure to catch the best light over La Concha mountain and the Mediterranean.

Which yachts are available for a photoshoot sunset session?

Our Tier A yachts – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – are ideal. Both have spacious open decks and clean lines for photos. Larger vessels like the Mangusta 80 are also available on request.

Can I bring my own photographer?

Yes, absolutely. You’re welcome to bring any professional or amateur photographer. The skipper will help with positioning the yacht for the best backdrop. If you need a photographer, we can arrange one through our concierge.

What is included in the €749 price?

The 2-hour charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No extra charges – just show up with your camera.

How many people can join the photoshoot?

The Astondoa 40 holds up to 9 passengers, the Azimut 39 up to 11. That includes the photographer and any models or guests. For larger groups, consider our Mangusta 80 (12 pax) – ask for a custom quote.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, we offer a 50% refund or a reschedule subject to availability. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable.

Can I add extras like champagne or flowers?

Yes – we can arrange a bottle of Moët & Chandon (€90), a bouquet of roses (€45), or a fruit platter (€35). Just let us know at least 24 hours in advance via WhatsApp.

Is the yacht private for the session?

Yes, every charter is private – only your group and the skipper are on board. No shared trips. You have full control over the route, stops, and timing during your sunset session.
